rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY INTO THE NATIONAL FOOD CORPORATION AND THE FOOD DEVELOPMENT AND REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION, REDEFINING THEIR POWERS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Scheduled for meeting/hearing on 2014-11-24

committee_action.meethigh: The Technical Working Group was created , to be headed by Rep. Agapito Guanlao, to harmonize the bills and discuss related food security issues that need legislation.

As a result of the series of public hearings,particularly in Tuguegarao, Cagayan, General Santos City and Cebu City, the Joint Committee came up with a draft substitute bill which was presented to the Body for further deliberation. Amendments were introduced and the draft was thereby approved with all members present as co-authors. The Secretariat was directed to finalize the bill; send the final draft to the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCC), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance, (DoF), and relevant agencies for their comments and recommendations; and set a clarificatory meeting of the joint panel with the concerned agencies.

Position papers and recommendations from the concerned agencies, particularly the National Food Authority (NFA), Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCGs), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Finance (DoF) and other relevant agencies, were presented to the Body  for possible amendments to the draft substitute bill.

committee_action.meethigh:
The Committee on Basic Education and Culture and Committee on Higher and Technical Education convened a technical working group (TWG) meeting on March 17, 2015 (1:30-2:30pm) at Speaker Fuentebella Hall, South Wing Annex Building, House of Representatives, Quezon City, to refine and consolidate the provisions of the following:

House Bills Numbered 2277, 2646 and 2886 - AN ACT PROVIDING FOR MANDATORY ANNUAL INSPECTION OF ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOL BUILDINGS BY THE CITY OR MUNICIPAL ENGINEER OR BUILDING OFFICIAL AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES by Reps. Velarde, Arroyo, D. and Arroyo, G. and Calixto-Rubiano, respectively 

The TWG agreed on the following:

1)	Consolidate the provisions of the three (3) bills and harmonize them with the provisions embodied in the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 9154 (Revised Fire Code of 2008) and Presidential Decree No. 1096 (National Building Code of the Philippines);  and

2)	Provide for a longer inspection time (6 months) to allow repairs and maintenance check to be done in the school premises.

committee_action.meethigh:
Creation of a TWG to study the provisions of the following bills in accordance with Republic Act No. 10533 or the     Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013, 

â€¢	House Bill No. 2464 - AN ACT REQUIRING INCLUSION OF BASIC FINANCIAL    MANAGEMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP AS SEPARATE SUBJECTS IN THE ELEMENTARY AND HIGH SCHOOL CURRICULA, RESPECTIVELY by Rep. Vargas, and

â€¢	House Bill No. 2700 - AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INCLUSION OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP AS A SUBJECT IN THE HIGH SCHOOL CURRICULUM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR by Rep. A.G. Del Rosario.

With Congresspersons A. Vargas, A. Del Rosario, T. Almario and representatives from the private sector financial institution, and Department of Education as members thereof.

The Committee on Basic Education and Culture conducted technical working group (TWG) meetings on February 12, 2015 (8:00-11:00am) at Kuppa Roastery and Cafe, Taguig City and February 23, 2015, 10:00 a.m. at Rep. A. Vargasâ€™ Office, House of Representatives, Quezon City to refine the provisions of House Bills Numbered 2464 and 2700 re INCLUSION OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP AS A SEPARATE SUBJECT IN THE BASIC EDUCATION CURRICULUM

The TWG agreed on the following:

1)	Change entirely the provisions of the two (2) bills that will aim to support and promote the existing Program of the Department of Education on Youth Entrepreneurship and Cooperativism.  Hence, the bill shall focus on the promotion of Youth Entrepreneurship and Financial Literacy Program; 

2)	The DepEd will provide for the language of some provisions that is consistent with Sec. 5 (Curriculum Development) of Republic Act 10533, otherwise known as the Enhance Basic Education Program;

3)	An Entrepreneurship Education Committee shall be created to ensure the implementation of the provisions of this Act including the duties of each stakeholder mentioned in the bill; and

4)	The Title of the substitute bill shall now read as follows:  

â€œAN ACT PROMOTING THE ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND FINANCIAL LITERACY PROGRAM AMONG THE FILIPINO YOUTH BY INSTITUTING MECHANISMS AND STRATEGIESâ€�.
Committee Report No. 631 on House Bill No. 5603, in substitution of House Bills Numbered 2464, 2700, 2877 and 4713.
